articleTitle: Implementing a Novel Low Complexity CNN Model for Brain Tumor Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: All over the world, thousands of people die yearly from brain tumor disease. It is considered a life-threatening, prominent, and serious disease. Thus, saving people-life requires automated detection and well-timed analysis of brain tumors. Accurate detection is the first and most important stage in diagnosing and treating brain tumors. Recently, the deep learning approach has been widely used in the medical sector, especially in diagnosing brain tumors. This paper introduces a novel low-complexity CNN model for detecting brain tumors using MRI images. A freely available dataset from Kaggle is employed. Initially, to select the baseline model, four famous CNN models, involving AlexNet, VGG-16, GoogLeNet, and ResNet-50, are examined and trained from scratch. The AlexNet model showed the best performance and got the highest accuracy of 98.8%. After improving it by inserting different layers, the proposed model reached an accuracy of 99.4%. To attain a low-complexity model, the final model has twenty-two layers, including nine convolutional blocks and four dropout layers. Other performance metrics include 99.67% precision, 99.02% recall, and 99.35% F1 score.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Segmentation Utilizing Generative Adversarial, Resnet And Unet Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: A brain tumor is an uncontrolled growth of brain cells in brain cancer that is not recognized at an early stage. Early brain tumor detection is critical for treatment planning and patient survival. Manual brain tumor identification is difficult, time-consuming, and error-prone. As a result, computer-assisted automated diagnosis was required to aid clinicians due to its high accuracy and speed of diagnosis. This article presents segmentation using deep learning networks on the Kaggle data set. The preprocessing and data augmentation concepts were introduced to enhance the classification rate. The multi-classification of brain tumors is performed to extract significant features from MRI slices using evolutionary algorithms and reinforcement learning through transfer learning. Brain tumor multi-classification is performed using transfer learning, U-Net, and Resnet architectures. Results thus obtained exhibited that the proposed research framework performed better than reported in the state of the art. Different CNN models were applied for tumor classification: U-net, and Resnet attained an accuracy of 80.0 and 90.2%, respectively. However, Resnet exhibited the highest accuracy.

articleTitle: Investigation Malware Analysis Depend on Reverse Engineering Using IDAPro
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Any software that runs malicious payloads on victims’ computers is referred to as malware. It is an increasing threat that costs people, businesses, and organizations a lot of money. Attacks on security have developed significantly in recent years. Malware may infiltrate both offline and online media, like: chat, SMS, and spam (email, or social media), because it has a built-in defensive mechanism and may conceal itself from antivirus software or even corrupt it. As a result, there is an urgent need to detect and prevent malware before it damages critical assets around the world. In fact, there are lots of different techniques and tools used to combat versus malware. In this paper, the malware samples were analyzing in the Virtual Box environment using in-depth analysis based on reverse engineering using advanced static malware analysis techniques. The results Obtained from malware analysis which represent a set of valuable information, all anti-malware and anti-virus program companies need for in order to update their products.

articleTitle: Handwritten Text Recognition Using CRNN
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Text recognition is one of the significant and demanding jobs that needed to keep diving into finding the stability result because of the wide range of real-world applications' use. Individual characters are often detected and recognized independently using traditional methods. Character detection is commonly achieved through the use of sliding windows or related components. The performance of these kinds of algorithms does not work well when the quality of the source image is poor or the image is complex. Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network (CRNN) is a deep learning-based end-to-end text recognition system applied in this study to recognize indefinite-length text sequences. The study proposes CRNN for text recognition where the study will detect the line of text with curvature words by detecting the word area and then will use it to recognize the words one by one by a model trained using CRNN with the IAM dataset words. Accordingly, the Character Error Rate (CER) reached 4.57.

articleTitle: Medical Images Classification Using Hybrid Deep Learning CNN-PSO-GA
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) has made outstanding achievements in image processing and detection. The recent research uses CNN to classify the medical images, but this performance depends on its hyperparameters chosen by the programmer. Choosing these parameters is a difficult process if done manually, so there is a need to find out alternative methods. To solve this problem, the researchers hybridized a CNN with particle swarm optimization (PSO) to find better values for these hyperparameters. PSO was hybridized using genetic algorithm to solve the retired particle problem. The purpose of this research is to take advantage of the achievements of deep learning in classifying medical images. The proposed model was tested with three datasets: malaria, COVID-19, and pneumonia. The model achieved 99.5%, 100%, and 99.7% accuracy for the above datasets respectively. These results were compared with the results of the standard CNN; the proposed model surpassed the standard CNN in overall performance.

articleTitle: Ad-hoc Mobile Network Performance Evaluation Using Throughput and Delay for Different Routing Protocols
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Throughput and delay are one of the most important criteria used to measure wireless network efficiency. The protocol used to route network data has a significant effect on the network throughput and delay values. The routing protocol parameters have significant effects on throughput which lead to a significant effect on wireless network performance. In this research, nine scenarios were designed using the Opnet modeler to build a mobile Ad hoc network with respect to the parameters determined in each scenario. Three routing protocol tested (AODV, OLSR, and GRP) to find throughput optimal value. The results showed that the no. of nodes has shown higher notable effects on both network throughput and delay than other parameters, results shows also that the ADVO protocol offers better throughput than OLSR and the GRP in 40 and 80 nodes number.

articleTitle: Deep Feature Selection Model Based on Convolutional Neural Network and Binary Marine Predator Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: most image datasets in classification have several features that negatively affect classification accuracy. Dimensions are reduced and features are selected through the use of several metaheuristic algorithms such as the Marine Predators Algorithm (MPA) after they are converted from a connected region to a discrete region. In this study, We first obtain the features from the dataset images using ResNet-18, a powerful convolution neural networks (CNN) architecture, pretrained on ImageNet. Then the features are taken from fully connected layers (FC 1000) in ResNet-18 and input into the binary marine predator (BMPA) algorithm, where the inspired algorithm identifies the most pertinent features and removes the less pertinent and noisy features to improve the classification process, then the features are input into the support vector machine (SVM) classifier. The proposed approach has high efficiency and the ability to obtain higher classification accuracy and few advantages.

articleTitle: A New Simple 6D Hyperchaotic System with Non-Hyperbolic Equilibrium and Its Electronic Circuit
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: This work represents a sequential design of controlling from a 3D chaotic system to a simple 6D hyperchaotic system by adding three linear controllers via state feedback control and coupling strategies. The new 6D system has a unique non-hyperbolic equilibrium point with four positive Lyapunov exponents (LE). Moreover, some dynamic properties are analyzed which inclined equilibrium and their stability, dissipative, conservative, and multistability. In addition, the corresponding analog electronic circuit is designed and implemented to verify the new simple 6D hyperchaotic system. Finally, the NI Multisim simulation results observed from the digital oscilloscope are consistent with the mathematical simulation based on the Matlab R2021a.

articleTitle: Analysis of Stability and Chaos of Discrete Time System with Local Bifurcation
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: This article deals with a two-dimensional time-distributed system. Three non-linear terms are included in the system's seven basic terms. The fundamental properties of the system are analyzed by means of fixed points, we obtained two fixed points which are real and two are complex. stability analysis by using (Characteristic Equation Roots Test, Jury Test and Lyapunov Function Test) the turbulence and chaotic behavior of the system indicated by phase portrait, hoph bifurcation, dispativity, and Lyapunov dimensions. Also, simulation was done by fixed point iteration method to get the optimal solution with (x,y)=(-0.0568, 0.0012). The maximal Lyapunov exponent and Lyapunov dimension are (0.0012878294) and (1.46271321), respectively, indicating the system is chaotic. Finally, using an adaptive control technique, a stable system path was established with an optimum controller.

articleTitle: Intelligent system for Classification ECG Based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN)
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: The electrocardiogram (ECG) is a non-invasive procedure used to diagnose cardiovascular disorders. The 2D ECG system gives important information on the electrophysiology of heart illnesses and possible brain changes, as well as important information about the cardiovascular system’s functional characteristics. The classification proposed system detected four different classes from the ECG cases: myocardial infarction (MI), Arrhythmia, History MI, and Normal case. The suggested system used three steps for classification ECG, include: Image processing, feature extraction, and classification. The first step involves utilizing Image preprocessing methods to prepare and enhance the input images, which includes two steps: converting RGB images to a binary image and applying filters to reduce noise from a binary image. Utilizing local binary pattern algorithm, features are retrieved from the images in the second step (LBP). The collected characteristics are then supplied into a 1D "convolutional neural network" (1D-CNN) model for object detection and classification in the third step. The findings demonstrate that the suggested model of the CNN has a high accuracy rate, with a classification accuracy rate of 97 percent. The suggested method works extremely well in the categorization of the 2D ECG, as demonstrated by the low rate of false alarms and high rate of accuracy.

articleTitle: Efficiency and Effectiveness in Utilizing Blended Learning in Context Aware Ubiquitous Learning Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Blended learning is widely spreading and uses many technologies as well as many serves learning objects. Various methods and models implemented and developed in this field. Blended learning definition, components, tools, and aspects are modified according to the rapid evolution of learning subjects, materials, and resources. Meantime the presence of context aware ubiquitous learning opens the way for enabling learners to learn about various subjects in learning systems that are free from the restrictions of time and place. Additionally, efficiency and effectiveness requirements of any learning framework have high consideration when applying any learning theory in particular subject. This paper presents a proposed framework with a summarization of the factors, criteria, and possible ways to achieve efficiency and effectiveness of utilizing blended learning models in context aware ubiquitous learning systems.

articleTitle: Modification to Queueing System M/M/1 with Blum-Blum-Shub Generator
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Queueing theory is a mathematical method which is used to investigate the queueing system behavior. In addition, it helps the facilities to build a queueing system for managing the waiting-line. In this paper, the researchers modified a type of queueing model simulation which is called ‘M/M/1’ by using a part of Blum-Blum-Shub algorithm. The simulation results reveals that the arrangement of waiting-line is mostly equivalent in graphs, yet there is a difference in the rate interval boundaries. It becomes lower than the original M/M/1 simulation. That leads to present an indication of predicting the optimal waiting-line to manage the queueing process in consuming a minimal time. More precisely, the total average of mean number of boxes in queue of MM1 and MM1BBS are (0.9027 and 0.2560), and the mean delay in the system evaluated as (0.0481 and 0.03373), while the utilization rates are (0.5498 and 0.5707).

articleTitle: PAPR Performance Analysis of SC-FDMA and SC-FDMA-DSCDMA
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiple Access (OFDMA) is a new version of OFDM that allows multi-user access based on orthogonal frequency division by allocating time-frequency sub-channels to distinct users. OFDMA has numerous advantages, including increased power spectrum efficiency and reduced effect of the multipath channel. Despite the many advantages offered by OFDMA technology, which made it widely used, the OFDMA suffers from a high Peak-Average-powerRatio (PAPR) problem. SC-FDMA is one of the approaches proposed by 3GPP to reduce PAPR and is now used in 4G uplink. There is still a need to improve the SC-FDMA system’s performance by lowering the PAPR value. SC-FDMA-DSCDMA technology is proposed in this work, which is a hybrid technology that combines SC-FDMA with DS-CDMA technology. The proposed system was done upon multiple users, up to 128, using two modulation types (QPSK and 16PSK) with two kinds of subcarriers mapping (localized and interleaved). The simulation results proved that SC-FDMA-DS-CDMA has a better PAPR than SC-FDMA.

articleTitle: A Frequency Reconfigurable Monopole Antenna Diversity for 5G Wireless Communication and IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: This study discusses a reconfigurable monopole antenna with a low-profile microwave frequency. The proposed structure has a shape like the Christmas tree is printed on an FR4-epoxy substrate with a permittivity of 4.4 and a tangent loss of 0.002 to get the desired results. Between the radiating patches of an antenna are three-pin diode switches that allow it to flip between various operational modes. Mode1 includes single band operation at 4.43 GHz. in Modes 2 and 3, dual band operation at 3.5 and 5.66 GHz, and 3.1 and 5.5 GHz, respectively. Mode 4 tri bands (i.e., 2.9, 5.2, and 5.7 GHz). VSWR (voltage standing wave ratio) is less than 1.4 for all operational bands given by the antenna provided. With matched resonance frequencies, the antenna's efficiency ranges from 73% to 93%, and its gain from 1.39 to 2.57 dBi. From 6.5% to 24.15 %, the bandwidths at the relevant frequencies could be acquired. Computing technology's microwave studio (CST MWS) simulates the proposed structure, which undergoes experimental verification. Because of its small size and compatibility with a wide range of wireless protocols, the proposed antenna may be used in current portable 5G devices and IoT-enabled equipment in intelligence.

articleTitle: Solving the Delay Differential Equations by Using the SEJI Integral Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: In this paper, the suggested transform namely (Sadiq- Emad- Jinan) integral transform and denoted by “SEJI” integral transform is applied to solve a linear second-order delay differential equation with the initial-value problem for the equation. Firstly, we introduce the form of this equation and provide examples of its use in a wide variety of scientific disciplines. Then the proposed transform is defined and describe its essential features as well as the value of the SEJI integral transform for derivatives. After that, proved a theorem for getting the precise answer by using “SEJI integral transform”. The theoretical results were illustrating by a concrete example as presented above. As a result, an appropriate conclusion was introduced for this work.

Author Keywords: the inverse of SEJI integral transform
the SEJI integral transform of derivatives

articleTitle: Pediment New Parameters for a Conjugate Gradient Method And Using it in Restoring Distorted Images
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Conjugate gradient methods are considered one of the most important famous methods for solving unconstraint optimization problems; in addition to that they can be applied in engineering, medical and computer science fields. In this paper, presented new formulas for the conjugate gradient coefficient based mainly on the Taylor series of the quadratic model, and proved the new algorithms are globally convergent and fulfill the descent condition. The numerical results showed the efficiency of the proposed algorithms by comparing them with the famous FR algorithm and use the new algorithms to process the distorted images and remove the impulse noise, and the results were satisfactory.

articleTitle: Behavioral Features of Users as a Security Solution in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: A large number of establishments and organizations implement clouds to store their databases. More active attacks are used on clouds to get unauthorized access or to do harmful actions that may affect on user’s privacy. Therefore, many studies have proposed to increase the level of security in the clouds depended on several strategies. The behavior is one of the promising strategies that might prevent unauthorized or processes. In this paper, a set of features, are from several previous studies, and these features are based on the user activity and events in a special purpose cloud by which unauthorized process can be prevented and alert user about bad actions during his/her work in the cloud environment. The results of comparison show that the event-based features require less resources and time. Thus, they need to be enhanced by adding more informative features, or some available features form other strategies.

articleTitle: Dynamic Iris-Based Key Generation Scheme during Iris Authentication Process
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: The robustness of the encryption systems in all of their types depends on the key generation. Thus, an encryption system can be said robust if the generated key(s) are very complex and random which prevent attackers or other analytical tools to break the encryption system. This paper proposed an enhanced key generation based on iris image as biometric, to be implemented dynamically in both of authentication process and data encryption. The captured iris image during the authentication process will be stored in a cloud server to be used in the next login to decrypt data. While in the current login, the previously stored iris image in the cloud server would be used to decrypt data in the current session. The results showed that the generated key meets the required randomness for several NIST tests that is reasonable for one use. The strength of the proposed approach produced unrepeated keys for encryption and each key will be used once. The weakness of the produced key may be enhanced to become more random.

articleTitle: A Survey Study on Extracting Trending Topics from Textual Data
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: This Survey presents a study on the amount of data available around us from its various sources, then provides an explanation of trending topics and their benefits in our daily lives. In fact, this survey presents the most important and latest data analytic techniques in the field of natural language processing, which are used on text data in order to take advantage of the huge amount of data around us and not to waste them. Finally, the research talks about comparing the details of thirteen researches conducted on different data from different sources and using multiple methods of analysis and processing to find Trending Topics. Each research includes results for accuracy measures, finding the best one among them. This survey will be useful for three types of readers, first: readers who want to learn about some of the means or resources of collecting huge data from the Internet, second: readers who want to know the means of data analysis to get useful results, and third: readers who want to quickly employ the collected data and the best data analysis technique in order to choose a method that is useful in extracting the trending topics in their projects through the results of the accuracy given and the avoidance of risks in choosing methods that are not feasible for a particular project.

articleTitle: Applying Template Matching Technique for Distortion Removing from Photography
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: The paper aims to remove distortion from analog media like old photographs due to several reasons like shredding and using multiple template matching techniques. First of all, is to convert the determined photograph into its digital representation to get the pixels’ intensities, then we extract the distorted templates to manipulate them by scanning the templates one by one on the whole image to determine the template position in the image, this achieved by applying Structural Similarity Index Measurement SSIM metric between the determined distorted template and the corresponding template in the whole image, this process is called matching step, then after determining the distorted template, now we will apply the proposed algorithm (equations) on that template to remove the distortion, also we applied a comparison using both SSIM and Mean Squared Error MSE metrics to determine the optimal template size depending on the following factors processing efficiency and execution speed.

articleTitle: Involving New Coefficients Conjugate Gradient Method for Restoring Distorted Images
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Conjugate gradient methods are one of the most common iterative mathematical techniques of their usefulness in optimizing linear and non-linear systems. In this paper, a new conjugated gradient formula based on a second order Taylor series is proposed and we also use Perry’s conjugacy to derive the coefficient of the new method. The proposed method achieves the property of sufficient descent and always globally convergent under certain assumption. The numerical results show that the method is effective to restore the original image of an image affected by impulse noise.

articleTitle: Design a CPW-Fed Circular Polarization Printed Antenna for 5G Sub-Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: In this paper, a coplanar waveguide-fed (CPW) printed antenna with circular polarization is suggested for the sub-6 GHz 5th generation spectrum. The proposed antenna is characterized by its single metallic layer being printed on one side of an FR4 substrate dielectric material with epsilon value ($\varepsilon_{r}$) of 4.4 and tangent loss (tan$\delta$) of 0.02. The total size of the suggested antenna is 30$\times$ 23.2$\times $ 1 mm<sup>3</sup>. The results show a wide-impedance bandwidth starts at 3.9GHz and going up to more than 8GHz with an S<inf>11</inf> value smaller than -10dB (S<inf>11</inf>$\le$10 dB) and the axial ratio bandwidth (ARBW) varying from 4GHz to 7.38GHz with an axial ratio(AR) value smaller than -3dB. The gain varies from 2.8dB up to 4.18dB in the entire band. This antenna covers all the sub-6GHz frequency bands of the fifth generation (5 G) applications. The HFSS software is used to design and simulate the suggested antenna and the CST.Studio is used to validate the results.

articleTitle: A Novel Network Model for Artificial Intelligence Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: The field of Artificial Intelligence (AI) has noticeably developed in recent years. The literature includes a tremendous number of contributions proposed by worldwide researchers. These algorithms can be used for a variety of purposes such as classifications, clustering, and forecasting, to mention a few. The problem that researchers frequently face is the appropriateness of the algorithm they use for their data. Moreover, researchers usually benchmark their work with the literature, which also needs to select appropriate algorithms that fit their needs. Another problem that researchers face is that when developing a new algorithm or modify an existing they need to have extensive knowledge about algorithms. These issues may take a lot of time and effort that are consumed in exploring the literature. This research comes to provide a network model as a guide that gathers most of the AI available algorithms in the literature aiming to make it easier for researchers to understand AI algorithms. The proposed network model includes nodes and edges. Each node represents an AI algorithm and the edges are created among them when they have parameters in common. The findings show the efficiency of the proposed model in supporting researchers in selecting appropriate algorithms for their works. Finally, this work is considered novel since it collects most of the AI algorithms in a standalone model.

articleTitle: A New Reliable Computational Technique for Solving Linear and Nonlinear Wave-Like Equations
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: In this study, a new modification of the homotopy analysis method (HAM) called the Tarig homotopy analysis method (THAM) is proposed to the linear and nonlinear wave-like equations. The numerical simulations have been implemented to show that the THAM is very efficient and accurate. The obtained results revealed that the THAM is simple to implement and more convenient for non-linear problems arising in different fields of science.

articleTitle: A New Almost Unbiased Estimator for Linear Regression Model in Heteroscedastic or Correlated Errors
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: This paper presents an almost biased estimator with two parameters (k, d) to improve the estimator efficiency for linear regression model that have heteroscedastics or correlated errors and suffer from the problem of multicollinearity. The properties of the new estimator, the variance matrix, and the mean squared error (MSE), are computed in comparison with the other estimators, using the mean squared error criterion as a measure of fit. The new estimator appears to have better properties than the other estimators because its mean squared error is smaller than the others. Simulations, examples, and graphics are used to illustrate the results.

articleTitle: An innovative Approach to Predict Stock Prices at Stock Exchange Markets by Using Multi-Linear Heavy Tails Regression Model Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: This paper proposes a new method based on Multi-Linear Generalized Modified Bessel Regression as a successful alternative to the Multi-Linear Normal Regression and Artificial Neural Network Model to predict stock prices at stock exchange markets. The generalized modified Bessel linear regression model has five parameters: Position parameter, Measurement, and Shape Parameters. In this paper, we used a genetic algorithm to estimate these parameters and apply the proposed model to several real data of stock prices in the Iraqi exchange market. The results showed the superiority of the proposed generalized Bessel regression model on multi-linear normal regression and artificial neural network model depending on the (RMSE), (MAD) and (R<sup>2</sup>) criteria. The proposed model is thus capable of predicting typical stock markets.

articleTitle: A Safe Distance Monitoring System with an Ultrasonic Range Detector Sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Automobiles are one of the most useful and flexible ways to travel. But even though they are convenient and common, they are also very dangerous. Each year, collisions with other cars and stationary objects kill thousands of people. Exposure and evasion can help prevent many accidents caused by careless, tired, or drunk drivers. There is no standard collision detection feature in any car on the market right now, and there are no devices that spot potentially dangerous objects from a distance. The purpose of this paper is to present a proposed software application that uses a new technique to prevent accidents. Ultrasound sensors can detect many potential dangers. By improving the vehicle’s safety systems, the vehicle and sensor function normally until the sensor detects a possible threat. In our paper, the sensor will not send a signal until the car is 1 meter away from an obstacle. Several warnings exist. The system alerts the user of the distance remaining by lights, sounds, a buzzer, and an LCD. When the car gets near a barrier, it automatically stops. This feature helps if the driver is sleeping or inattentive. The proposed software system was written in C++ and Java using the Arduino IDE and MIT app inventor, respectively.

articleTitle: A Survey on Event Extraction from Webpage
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Event extraction (EE) is one of most important researches in the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP). Numerous significant events occur every day all over the world, and it published in various media outlets with varying narrative styles. A primary job in EE is to determine if events in the real world have been reported in articles and posts driven by the 4Ws’ (what, who, when, and where). A complex relationship between people can be explained by an event, place, actions, and objects. An event-centered model captures the dynamic and semantic aspects of an event representation of event facts. An updated and comprehensive survey is needed due to the proliferation of methods, datasets, and evaluation metrics in the literature. In this paper, a survey on extracting events from websites and defining their types and applications in several different fields has been discussed. In addition, the study presents the strengths and weaknesses of event extraction systems for different types of models

articleTitle: New Improvement for Successive Approximation Method
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Recently, the successive approximation method (SAM) has attracted the attention of many authors due to its simplicity, ease of use, and great results. However, the results obtained by SAM start to diverge when the time interval is increased. To address this issue, this paper develops an improved version of the SAM for solving non-linear Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) numerically. Here, the initial condition of the differential equations has been combined with the SAM to obtain stable and more accurate results. The test that was conduct included the original SAM and the improved one on the system of strongly non-linear PDEs. Experimental results revealed that the proposed technique gives better and more accurate numerical solutions regardless of the time interval used.

articleTitle: Parameters Estimate of Step-Stress in Accelerated Life Tests of Exp. Distribution with Type I Censor
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: The extensive use of electronic devices automatic mixing and simulation, the high quality of the manufacturing process has improved greatly, making the merchandise more reliable than its previous versions, obtaining failure data using normal failure life time testing is a time consuming and expensive process for such high reliability merchandise, Therefore, more complex tests are used, which are the Accelerated Life Testing, they are tests: Constant Accelerated Life Testing and Step Stress Accelerated Life Testing, which is the subject of our study. The step-stress model of the exponential distribution was studied in the presence of type I censoring data, and the model parameters were estimated using the maximum likelihood method for both parameters (the scale parameter of the exponential distribution, and the stress factor), and then estimating the confidence interval and calculating the variance and covariance.

articleTitle: Construction of Marshall-Olkin Lindley Distribution with Application
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: The one-parameter Lindley distribution was generalized by using the Marshall-Olkin family. This new distribution is named Marshall Olkin Lindley Distribution (MOL). The statistical properties of this new distribution have been studied, the parameters of (MOL) estimated by (ML) method. The results applied on simulated data with different sample sizes and different values of parameters. Also results applied on real data. In simulated data set, is concluded that MSE $(\hat{\theta})$ decrease with an increase in the value of shape parameter while MSE $(\hat{\alpha})$ increases with an increase of shape parameter. Also, MSE for scale parameters increases with the increase in the value of shape parameter and the constancy of the value of shape parameter and the sample size, for real data it’s concluded that follows a (MOL) distribution and the parameters estimated by (ML) method.

articleTitle: Extra Quasi-Newton Equation for Unconstrained optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Quasi-Newton equations play a central role in quasi-Newton methods for optimization and various quasi-Newton equations are available. The objective function’s third-order Taylor expansion has been used in this study to suggest a novel quasi-Newton equation. By adding more of the easily obtained values to the updated matrix, the goal is to enhance the accuracy of the Hessian (or its inverse) approximation. Under proper conditions, these methods are globally convergent for general functions and sometimes their numerical performance is superior to classical BFGS method. Modified versions of the quasi-Newton relation have recently been the focus of several papers with encouraging outcomes.

articleTitle: An Application of Dirac’s Delta Function in Bivariate Beta-Gamma Distribution
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: The Dirac delta function $\delta$(x)is one of the most important mathematical functions that is used successfully in physics and mathematics. Several authors have used this function to derive distributions of functions of random variables. This article consists of two main axes, namely, the use of change-of-variables technique and $\delta$(x) in deriving the ratio distribution of the two variables of bivariate Beta-Gamma distribution. The aim is to prove that $\delta$(x) is a successful alternative to the change-of-variables technique especially for complex density functions. An appropriate mathematical body of $\delta$(x) is proposed to achieve an adequate representation of the transformation task required for the target distribution. It has been proven that the two methods lead to the same result, which is that the ratio of the two variables follows a beta distribution and that $\delta$(x)is an easy and straightforward alternative to the traditional method.

articleTitle: Truncated Rayleigh Odd Weibull Exponential Distribution with Application to COVID-19 Data
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: A proposed truncated Rayleigh odd Weibull-G family with one ofits sub-models, truncated Rayleigh odd Weibull exponential distribution, are introduced. Several statistical properties along with linear representation, reliability measures, entropies, and reliability stress strength model are presented. The unknown parameters are estimated through the maximum likelihood method. Simulation and real application are used to evaluate the new distribution’s flexibility and usefulness. For different compared information criteria, the results clearly show that the proposed distribution has superior output relative to other competitive distributions demonstrating its consistent and flexible performance, as well as representing an optimal statistical model for the distribution of COVID-19 death cases in Iraq.

articleTitle: Image Encryption Algorithm based on A Novel 5D Chaotic System
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: The rapid advancement of computer and digital connections, as well as the increasing popularity of internet communication, led to an increase in the demand for secure data sharing. For a fast and efficient color image encryption technique a novel five-dimensional hyperchaotic system proposed in this research has traits like increased sensitivity to primary factors and conditions. As well as has two Lyapunov exponents that are positive demonstrate that the proposed system is hyperchaotic, add a new method was presented based on a hyperchaotic system to structure a color image cryptosystem to improve data security. In this proposed method, there are two stages. In the initial stages, the pixel locations of an image are confused in the permutation step by a chaotic sequence created, secondly, substitution stage, Using the XOR operation, between the pixel value of the image from the previous step with a pseudo-random number sequence (key2) created from the system proposed. The proposed algorithm was evaluated using Evaluation measures such as key space, key sensitivity, histogram, information entropy, unified average change intensity (UACI), and several pixel changes rates (NPCR). The proposed system’s efficiency and security it demonstrated by experimental results and performance evaluations, correlation coefficient values are acquired as -0.0003, 0.0075, and 0.0018 for H, V, and D directions, respectively. The entropy value is 7.9974 bits. The mean UACI and NPCR values are determined to be 33.4635% and 99.7061%, respectively. results showed that the suggested system’s properties are robust to various attacks.

articleTitle: BER Enhancement of M-ary BPSK Multi-Codes CDMA System based on ACO Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Wireless communications have achieved wide development in recent years. There is a great need for wireless communication services that reduce the effects of the transmission channel and transmit data with high data rates. There are many services that increase data transmission rate, such as M-ary BPSK Multi-Code CDMA system. The M-ary BPSK CDMA system has been designed and simulated using Walsh-Hadamard spreading code with lengths of 256, 128, 64, and 32 in the AWGN channel. An Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) algorithm is proposed to find the best constellation points for the M-ary BPSK system that improves the bit error rate performance of the system. The results demonstrate that the M-ary BPSK CDMA system based on the ACO algorithm to find the best constellation points outperforms the system that doesn’t depend on the best constellation points. The results proved that the bit error rate performance was improved by relying on the best set of constellation points in which about 2dB was gained, and this means that more users can be accessed at the same bit error rates. Also, the bit error rate performances for M=8 and M=16 are very close because the 16-ary used best constellation points, and three spreading codes were allocated for each user, while for the 8-ary system, two spreading codes were allocated for each user.

articleTitle: Capacity and Throughput Enhancement for Minimum Distance Using D2D Scheme with TCP for 5G System
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Device-to-Device (D2D) communications is a promising technology in (5G) cellular networks. It can bring more convenience to mobile phone user equipment (UE). As it can improve the system performance by benefiting the proximity of users together. In this paper, a simple model for single hop D2D communication in 5G is presented and implemented using OMNeT++ simulator and Simu5G software. The model is simulated and the throughput evaluations are presented. The paper explains the performance of D2D communications in infrastructure and D2D modes. As well it measures some parameters; such as uplink and downlink throughput and received bytes. The results show that the throughput in D2D mode is higher than in infrastructure mode, so D2D mode is better as the distance between D2D UEs decreased. It optimizes spectrum utilization, and increases the total throughput of the system, and capacity, with minimum distance.

articleTitle: Traffic-aware QoS Guaranteed SDN/NFV-5G Network with Multi-Layer Network Slicing and Resource Allocation
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Introducing Currently, there is a remarkably higher and more complex request for Quality of Service (QoS) that the current technologies cannot meet. The present study works towards increasing the QoS within fair Service Level Agreement (SLA) constraints, due to the difficulty in achieving QoS within SDN/NFV enabled 5G networks. Using Network Slicing (NS) technology and the Dijkstra algorithm were adopted to optimize the uses of network resource allocating and the QoS values. The network has been tested before and after running the Dijkstra algorithm and network slicing, with the main focus on QoS parameters like bandwidth, delay, jitter, latency, and packet loss among nodes within the network. For the test bed, the Mininet simulation platform is used in addition to the custom network topology, nodes, and other details whose management is controlled by the RYU controller during the SDN experiment. Finally, iPerf is used to evaluate the network performance.The resulting data indicates that a significant increase has been observed in regards to the network performance after the algorithm and network slicing were run., the network bandwidth was increased from 743.83(Kbits/sec) to 1.34(Mbit/sec) after running the algorithm. The Jitter has decreased from 41.61 to 0.1 (ms). Also, the Packet Loss and latency have decreased and reduced delay from 47.77 (ms) to 0.05 (ms). The network utilization has been improved and the traffic is controlled and managed using Network Slicing because each slice has its own set of requirements to meet the demands of various use cases. The technology efficiently allocates network resources for maximum cost-efficiency.

articleTitle: Simon Chaotic: An enhancement of SIMON block cipher by using Arnold and Henon chaotic maps
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: The US National Security Agency (NSA) developed a Simon lightweight block cipher in June 2013. It supports internet of things (IoT) environments. However, recently Simon has suffered from several attacks. The Problem of SIMON does not contain perfect confusion and diffusion processes. Furthermore, it has multiple iterative calculations. These iterative increase the computational effort. This paper proposes the fast initial and final permutations with the Substitution box (S-box) to get SIMON's confusion and diffusion processes to get perfect security with a few iterations against attacks. Furthermore, this paper improves the security of the Simon block cipher with keeps on the speed and memory level simultaneously by using chaotic maps (Arnold and Henon maps) to overcome their weaknesses by attacking. Analysis results of the proposed SimonChaotic algorithm based on NIST randomness tests show that this proposed algorithm is secure with keep on the speed and memory level compared with the original algorithm.

articleTitle: Coverless Message Hiding Technique based on Eye Blinking Activity
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Most existing methods for hiding data depend on the features present in each image or frame, so these characteristics will be lost when exposed to any attack. For this reason, in this work, we present a novel method based on an activity in the video. Our approach is to send a secret message using a de Bruijn sequence formed as voluntary blinks. The sender converts a secret text message into binary blocks using a Huffman coding tree and then builds a mapping table based on specified de Bruijn sequence dB(2,5) to create an index key which is needed at the receiver side to recover the secret message fragments, then the sender records a video of a person blinking voluntarily, long and short blinks, with the corresponding $0^{\prime}$s and $1^{\prime}$s in dB(2,5). The receiver reads stego-video frames, then for each frame, face detection and eye localization processes will be applied based on the mediapipe model, then the eye region passes into CNN to determine the state of the eye. Thus, define the type of blink if it is long or short, then the receiver translates long and short blinks into $0^{\prime}$s and $1^{\prime}$s in order to produce the sent dB(2,5). The experiment results showed that the accuracy of extracted secret bits was very high, reaching 100% if blinks were sent without any errors. As well, the experiments showed that the robustness reached 95.2%, which means the proposed method has more robustness against salt and pepper, Gaussian, speckle, cropping, rotation, and translation attacks) than other coverless data hiding techniques.

articleTitle: Early Detection of Diabetic Retinopathy Using ResNet50
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: With the rapid development of software engineering, various multimedia technologies, and continuous changes in the field of biotechnology, training convolutional neural networks (CNN) in the fields of life, especially in the healthcare sector, have become much easier and of great benefit to people. Smart technologies are one of the most important methods for detecting and preventing diabetic retinopathy (DNR), which is one among the main troubles of diabetes that threatens, vision. This is because identifying the disease at early illness recognition has been one of the biggest challenges for many years. This is why timely diagnosis can lessen the risk likelihood of developing not ne-proliferative DR. The proposed system analyzes the presence of micro-aneurysms, cotton wool spots, solid exudates, bleeding and new capillary formation in the fundus image using (ResNet 50) algorithm that provides rapid training and feature extraction with very good performance to classify or categorize the fundus image as normal or injured and the degree of injury out of four. It also shows whether the injured is mild, moderate, severe and proliferative. This offers an automated new system that helps ophthalmologists classify fundus images. The system was tested using 500 samples of Kaggle, and the proposed system achieved a high accuracy rate (91%) for early detection of DR.

articleTitle: LSTM Neural Network for Parkinson’s Disease Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Parkinson’s disease (PD) is a brain disorder and results in involuntary or uncontrollable movements, such as stiffening, tremors, and difficulty with balance and coordination; After Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s disease is the most common disease. Symptoms start gradually and get worse as the disease progresses. A person may experience difficulty in speaking and walking, behavioral and mental changes, sleep disturbances, tiredness, and depression. The most noticeable symptoms of the disease appear when nerve cells in a specific part of the brain weaken or die. This part of the brain is responsible for movement, and neurons produce an essential brain chemical known as dopamine, which is required to control movement in the human body. Deep learning can detect and predict various diseases, which have a significant impact on health care. This research aims to investigate the predictive capabilities of deep learning in diagnosing Parkinson’s disease, and the use of deep model is based on long-term memory (LSTM) in diagnosing disease based on a group, the data, and training. The model was conducted to prove its effectiveness, in addition to comparing it with traditional machine learning techniques where the results obtained showed that the accuracy of the LSTM model reaches 99 percent. which indicates its effectiveness in diagnosing Parkinson’s disease.

articleTitle: Improved UWB Antenna for 5G System Using Meta-Materials
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Four proposed antennas are discussed, and the best properties for fabrication have been selected in this article. The best property here is the gain, bandwidth and efficiency. The design steps were as follows. In the beginning, the UltraWide Band (UWB) antenna was designed with a traditional square shape, and then a part of it was trimmed in the shape of a stair, then two types of meta-materials were added to it, and the change was studied, and the best properties were selected. Meta-materials (MTM) have been added to the front and back of the antenna; the types of these (MTM) are squire split ring resonator (SRR) and circular SRR. To shorten the article, not all the details of this study, but only the results of it, were mentioned.

articleTitle: Solving Ordinary Differential Equations with Variable Coefficients by Using the SEJI Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: We have a new application that solves a set of ordinary differential equations with variable coefficients by using the suggested transform namely (Sadiq- Emad-Jinan) integral transform and denoted by “SEJ”I integral transform. In this paper a definition of the new transform is given and values of some elementary functions by using this transform, as well as the invers of this transform. Theorems are showed with proofs that used them in this work Also, some applications were introduced to explaining the method for solving ordinary differential equations with variable coefficients by using the suggested transform which can obtaining the exact solution.

Author Keywords: ordinary differential equations (ODEs) with variable coefficients
the inverse of SEJI integral transform
the SEJI integral transform of derivatives

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Classification of Multi-Component Shape Descriptors
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: The concept of Multi-component shapes is motivated by researchers in image classification and computer vision applications. In this paper, we have introduced several descriptors that are modified versions of the Hu moment invariants and suitable for measuring certain properties of multi-component shapes. These descriptors are invariant in translation, rotation, and scaling-based transformation, and this is important because they can significantly develop systems for object identification, classification, matching, and analysis. The classification of multiple objects from the MPEG-7 dataset is applied using the descriptors introduced in this research. Multiple machine learning classifiers are used to test the new descriptors’ performance, where SVM has shown notable results i.e., 87.5%, 88.96, 87.5, and 88.23 for Accuracy, Precision, Recall, and F1-score, respectively, as proof of the worthiness of new descriptors.

articleTitle: Designing Self-Managed E-Classroom
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Distance education and e-learning have been the subject of extensive research in recent years, particularly after the advent of the COVID-19 pandemic, which drove educational institutions to move from traditional face-to-face classrooms to online learning; consequently, courses have evolved. Massive Open Online Courses, or MOOCs, are online courses that are available to anybody who wishes to join. Many MOOC educational platforms, such as Coursera, Edx, and Udacity, provide students with recorded video lectures, online readings, examinations, and student-to-student and teacher-to- teacher interactions. However, these systems have several disadvantages, including costly prices, a lack of Arabic language support, and closed-source software. This paper focuses on the design and development of a massive open online course (MOOC) platform with self-managed learning (SML); so that, it can be used as a tool to improve education in the digital era. It should also be open-source and support the Arabic language. It is specifically designed for the University of Mosul to establish courses such as competency courses. The proposed system differs from existing LMSs in the sense that the order of activities is dictated by student actions and behaviors and is not the same for all students. SML guides student activities and behavior.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Smart Greenhouse and Experiment in Strawberry Cultivation
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Technology is essential and effective in several areas of our daily lives. One of these crucial areas is using the internet of things (IoT) technology in agriculture. Smart agricultural greenhouse solutions are one of the most essential applied solutions in agriculture, which can control and adjust the temperature via sensors. This paper proposes a smart greenhouse (SGH) based on IoT controllers, sensors, and components for strawberry cultivation.The soil moisture sensor has been used to measure soil moisture content and compares it to the ideal soil moisture value saved in the Arduino. If the humidity is less than the ideal values, the 5V pump will operate to bring the humidity level back to an acceptable level. The humidity sensor has been used to control temperature and humidity values, the lamp for heating, and the fan for cooling. The results of strawberry cultivation were compared between those grown traditionally and those grown using the proposed prototype. The results were encouraging, with an average number of leaves reaching (29,625), the plant height reaching (20,625), the average number of flowers reaching (51,975) and the average number of fruits reaching (45,125). This proposed prototype can be realistically applied in the strawberry greenhouse and thus contribute to reducing the use of resources and increasing productivity.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation a Multi-Rhombus Patch Fractal Antenna Structure for Human Wearable Device
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: The wearable fractal antenna is discussed in this study for wireless body area network (WBAN) applications. This type of antenna is used in biomedical applications in a safe and convenient manner operating in the frequency range (0-10) GHz. The proposed multi-rhombus patch antenna was designed using a low-cost and widely available substrate made of (FR-4) and ground and patch of copper material, this antenna achieved a bandwidth (5.98-7.44) GHz with a return loss of -41 dB. It has a resonant frequency of 6.30 GHz and a SAR result of 1.4 W/kg. CST studio software is used to design this antenna and body phantom.

articleTitle: A New Biased Stochastic Estimator for the Regression Model When There Are Problems of Multicollinearity and Heterogeneity
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: This paper deals with the estimation of parameters for linear regression model with stochastic linear restrictions, when model suffers from multicollinearity as well as heteroscedastic and/or correlated error. In order to solve these problems, a new stochastic restricted almost unbiased generalized ridge regression estimator has been proposed, and its effectiveness as a solution to those issues has been discussed. Because of this, we are able to derive the necessary and sufficient conditions for the superiority of the proposed estimator over other estimators in the sense of the mean squared error matrix. In addition, a numerical example is provided to illustrate the theoretical conclusions.

articleTitle: Incoming and Outgoing Mail Tracking System using Barcode
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Despite the importance of reliability when exchanging official books between the different state departments, the traditional paper-based methods used did not pay much attention to them, as they suffered from some limitations related to manual work errors as well as the attendant costs of transportation. It was realized that the process of sending and receiving unreliable information leads to a decrease in administrative work in terms of the lack of completion of official books. To provide a satisfactory completion rate by avoiding the unreliable method of sending and receiving, it has become necessary to propose a smart electronic system. It can be used to estimate the reliability of delivery under various sending and receiving conditions. The main objective of this study is to provide an efficient, accurate and easy-to-use system for the employees of the educational institution or any other organizations to ensure that all data sent and received is documented and easy to retrieve at any time and from anywhere. This can be achieved by proposing a smart and reliable electronic web-based system based on barcode technology to meet all employee needs. Interfaces for incoming and outgoing books and recipient identification are designed using programming languages. The system can improve administrative performance by overcoming many of the obstacles and problems associated with the traditional system with minimal effort and cost.
