articleTitle: Improve Compression Data Using Serial Combination Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Data Compression (DC) is an important issue in terms of digital communications systems because it places an important rule and reduces the complexity and power consumption. Various techniques were used for this task such as; Huffman, Shannon-Fano, LZW, and LZ4. In order to improve compression ratio (CR) which leads to more capacity saving and reduces the required bandwidth in terms of the communications system, this paper proposed a combination system which consists of a serial two techniques. The combination system achieve a decrease in the file size by 78.832%, 76.68%, and 78.139%, respectively when compared to Huffman, Shannon-Fano, and LZW. The required payment of the proposed system is to increase the execution time (ET) by 1.2 over traditional techniques. The proposed combination system is very important in modern communications systems with a huge data transferring and saving.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Scheduling Meeting System Using Mobile Agent
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: In recent years, as a result of rapid development, the scheduling of meetings has become costly and time-consuming. Many systems that support the scheduling of meetings have been developed and they are independently finding the appropriate scheduling date and duration of the meeting. In this research, the Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) is used to find out the appropriate time for meeting since agent is able to cooperate and execute autonomy. An algorithm was proposed to deal with the participants’ leisure time and to make the appropriate decision to determine the date and duration of the meeting. The scheduling system collects free time from several persons (every person has an agent) and decides the appropriate meeting date, duration, and time for holding the meeting and publishing it to all attenders. The number of attenders in the designed system is between (4-7), with the presence of the manager (The manager Agent) who is responsible for organizing the meeting. The system was developed using multi-agent systems. JADE (Java Agent Development Framework) is used under java language to design the system for its capabilities. The system provides easy and clear interfaces for users. The system is compared with other previous work and shows that its lightness to the network. Also, the proposed system provides an interface with no need to send messages using SMS or any other media.

articleTitle: On the Use of Virtual Reality in Visualizing Interactive Network Models for Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: The current revolution in technology forces most daily life systems to generate large-scale data. Understanding such data is not an easy task due to its size and complexity. Therefore, data visualization has played a key role in understanding our data more clearly. Moreover, most of the available approaches for data visualization are considered traditional that deal with data in a 2D way. Furthermore, one of the modern methods for data visualization is converting data into network models that include nodes and edges. This kind of visualization has been proved as an efficient way of analyzing large-scale data. On the other hand, with the advent of virtual reality technology, data can be visualized and analyzed in an interactive and 3D way. Hence, this research investigates the integration of virtual reality technology and complex networks, and how it can generate interactive data visualization models. This research provides a novel investigation of the literature by presenting the modernist methods that enable researchers to interact with their data. Also, in this work, a 3D VR-based biological network model is built. Finally, this work may open the horizon to metaverse developers in developing interactive network models in the future (e.g., biological networks, social networks, etc.).

articleTitle: Machine Learning based – System for Prediciting Mastitis in Dairy Cows
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: In this work, a comparative study on high-efficiency machine learning algorithms for the goal of incorporating machine learning and Veterinary Medicine has been conducted. In this study, six machine learning algorithms have been used to predict Mastitis in dairy cattle. The study has applied SVM, RandomTree, RandomForest, J4S, j4Sgraft, CSForest classification algorithms on a benchmark dataset of Mastitis on dairy cattle. To evaluate the performance of the algorithms, the study has relied on the four measures: Accuracy, True Positive Rate or detection rate, False Positive Diagnosis Rate (FPR) or False Alarm Rate (FAR) and F-measure. For the dairy cattle Mastitis detection data set, all the decision trees outperformed the SVM algorithm by scoring the perfect score (100%) based on the Accuracy, F-measure and Detection Rate and 0% in FAR scales. After applying the SMOTE technique, the performance of SVM has been improved in terms of accuracy from 85% to 94% and the FAR has been decreased from 70% to 5%. Moreover, the SVM performance has been improved in this study to the perfect score in all metrics by using the normalization technique.

articleTitle: Based Complex Key Cryptography: New Secure Image Transmission Method utilizing Confusion and Diffusion
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Recently, the transport massive and secure data are fateful and difficult in communication over the IoT. Due to their widespread use and ease of transmission, images are the most frequent and well-liked multimedia data format. Among the various cryptography methods, chaos-based image cryptography is regarded as the one that is best suitable for picture applications due to its sensitivity to the beginning circumstances and control parameters. Conventional image cryptography techniques have employed confusion and diffusion techniques, but the perfect encrypted image has not yet been produced. Secure image transmission is the main goals in proposed method. Therefore, the new chaos method based on confusion and diffusion method is introduced to secure the image transmission. Generally, the confusion technique is used to produce random numbers for the pixel permutation method. While the random matrix is produced using the diffusion approach. The main idea of the proposed method is to idealize the histogram and information entropy of the ciphered image. The experimental results demonstrated that comparing the suggested strategy to benchmark methods stimulates better results. The experimental result showed that the test of the proposed method encourages outcomes against benchmarked methods.

articleTitle: Exploring Attitudes Concerning The Applying Of Mobile Learning In Technical Education With Responsibility And Generativity
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Mobile learning is a real issue that has attracted the interest of a students and academics. Despite the fact that m-learning is quickly growing around the world, research into students’ and instructors’ views regarding its use is still limited. One of the concerns identified in this study is that some students have a poor comprehension of the use of smartphone apps. Many problems highlight the need for a stronger emphasis on training to provide technical students with adequate e-learning and mobile learning skills so that they can take use of smartphone technology’s capabilities. To show the state of the art of M-learning, a sample of two hundred and one participants is purposely chosen from technical university students. It focuses at how learners and educators feel about using and adopting M-learning. M-learning has been defined in terms of its integration and deployment with other technology resources. Students’ views on the usage of M-learning have been proven as a result of many factors. After using the application with the same group of students, they stated their satisfaction and satisfaction with it, as well as the influence of its usage in improving the educational students’ performance in this topic. The results of this analysis revealed that in deploying smartphone applications for educational purposes, participants value rapid and simple access to information. Participants suggested potential applications of smartphones in using smartphone applications for educational reasons within Blackboard learning environment, in addition to highlighting the convenience of accessing information.

articleTitle: The Prediction of COVID-19 Virus Mutation Using Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: A worldwide epidemic has been caused by the new coronavirus (COVID-19). The high transmission rate of this pathogen requires early prediction and appropriate identification of mutations. Predicting this evolution will aid in the early detection of new strains and potentially facilitate the design of more effective antiviral therapies. However, SARS-CoV, MERS-CoV, and SARS-CoV2 (known as COVID-19) are all challenging to predict because of the virus's polymorphic nature, which enables it to adapt and survive across species, so there is a strong need for prediction to characterize mutations using their genetic information. A working method based on deep learning has been proposed to identify unknown sequences of pathogens to mitigate this problem. This study aims to predict virus mutations, especially codon mutations, for six types of coronavirus mutations (MERS-CoV, SARS-CoV-l, SARS-CoV-2, Alpha, Beta, Gamma). In this work, long-term memory is used for base prediction as an alignment-free technique. This algorithm is applied to several DNAs of coronavirus mutations where the k-mer technique is applied to segment the data to create a unique vocabulary. Then the TF-IDF is subsequently used for the identified virus sequences. The results showed that this technique's predictive accuracy on this data set reached 99%. It should be noted that this model was developed in Python using the Keras library, which is part of the Tensorflow library.

articleTitle: Using TGARCH and ARMA-GARCH Models to Predict the Volatility in OPEC Oil prices
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Some series are characterized to be of high volatility over time, especially with economic movements, such as stock prices or financial transactions and have heteroscedasticity problems stock markets, which are characterized to be non-stationary over time. This paper aims to choose the ideal model for predicting the volatility of the OPEC oil price for the period from 1/2/2003 to 31/12/2021 by applying different autoregressive heteroscedasticity models that is, GARCH model, TGARCH and ARMA-GARCH model when a mistake occurs Student’s-t distribution. The results show that the best model for oil price volatility is ARMA (1,1)-GARCH(I,I) based on AIC, SIC and H-Q criteria and MAE, RMSE accuracy measures.

articleTitle: Application of Convolution Neural Networks and Randomforest for Software Test
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: The system development life cycle includes a phase called software testing. Lots of tests are done to test the software. Here, we will focus on how to use Oracle Testing to test system output using black box testing methodology. We will test credit card software as an example, and the results will indicate whether or not a financial institution can authorize credit cards to its customers. This paper explains how to check the output of the credit card application using Convolutional Neural Networks and the Random Forest Algorithm, which will represent the Oracle test, according to the black box testing methodology, using machine learning algorithms, which can be adopted in the next versions of the credit card software to verify the validity of the results. The aim of this paper is to give results about whether a financial institution can approve credit cards for its customers. The decision to approve the card is made by the financial companies based on consideration of various reasons related to individuals which vary from creditworthiness, loans, repayment history and income criteria.

articleTitle: A Systematic Literature Survey of Emotion Detection of Students in E-learning
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Affective computing is a part of artificial intelligence, which is becoming more important and widely used in education to process and analyze large amounts of data. Consequently, the education system has shifted to an E-learning format because of the COVID-19 epidemic. Then, e-learning is becoming more common in higher education, primarily through Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs). This study reviewed many prior studies on bolstering educational institutions using AI methods, including deep learning, machine learning, and affective computing. According to the findings, these methods had a very high percentage of success. These studies also helped academic institutions, as well as teachers, understand the emotional state of students in an e-learning environment.

articleTitle: Wireless Sensor Networks Designs and Protocols: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Modern world is full of devices, and sensors, including smartphones, computers, air conditioning devices, intelligent cars, surveillance systems, cameras, smart homes, and others such devices are ruled and controlled using protocols. This research paper is a comprehensive survey of those protocols that deal with wireless sensor networks, since their inception and until the end of 2020. The pros and cons of each are mentioned in more than one article and scientific research in this field. The research also refers to the scientific background of sensors and their design, besides their protocols.

articleTitle: Software Quality Measurement Analysis based on Techniques, Criteria, Metrics, Models, and Datasets
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Software quality measurement considers a very crucial process in developing software. Achieving high-quality software leads to produce software with high efficiency, and reliability and to reduce the software cost. This study intends to explain the most important factors that have direct effects on the software quality measurement process. In addition, this study summarized the software quality models; where each model could be classified into various scopes such as reliability, functionality, usability, portability, and maintainability. Moreover, the most recent techniques, which are used in software quality measurement, are concluded. Furthermore, the vital metrics that play an important role in the measurement process have been determined. Last but not least, the most commonly used datasets in software quality measurement in many aspects and scopes have been presented. As a result, this paper drew the road map for future work in the field of software engineering to accomplish more research work in developing novel software quality measurement approaches based on machine learning techniques such as deep learning methods and ensemble techniques that may give promising results.

articleTitle: An Overview of Machine Learning Approaches to Software Development Cost Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Software cost estimation still presents a real challenge to software development firms and practitioners. One of the crucial activities in project management is software cost estimation. The accuracy of the estimated cost has a critical impact on the project’s success or failure. Overestimation and underestimation are serious challenges to project managers, especially in today’s competitive marketplace. Inaccurate estimation may lead to over budget, missing deadlines, business loss, and even project failure. The precise cost estimation will enable the project manager to forecast and allocate the necessary resources to deliver a successful product. Many researchers have published research papers in this area. In this paper, the study’s goal is to outline the recent machine learning approaches to software cost estimation. The study will address the problems with conventional cost estimation models and provide a comprehensive review of the researches regarding software cost estimation with machine learning. The current study will discuss the intelligence models for software cost estimation and highlight the models that excel in this area.

articleTitle: Gene Expression Dataset Classification Using Machine Learning Methods: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: The process of converting the instructions in the DNA of human beings into a functional product such as proteins is called gene expression. Gene expression is an organized process that allows the cell to adapt to its changing environment after converting the information stored in DNA into instructions, forming the basis for making protein and other molecules. It is a tightly regulated process that allows a cell to respond to its changing environment. Gene expression classification is important because it helps a lot in the prediction, prevention, and early control of some genetic diseases. Bioinformatics is a broad field that specializes in developing software methods and techniques for analyzing and understanding biological data, especially large ones that are difficult to analyze without software assistance. Bioinformatics is not limited to biology and computer sciences only, but chemistry, physics, mathematics, statistics, and information engineering participate in this discipline to help analyze and interpret large-scale biological data. Machine learning methods are used extensively in bioinformatics on the biological data sets and provide good results, such as Random Forest and Support Vector Machine. In this paper, a comprehensive survey is made of the recently used machine learning methods for gene expression classification.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Approach for Semantic Plagiarism Detection in Scientific Papers
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Plagiarism is the attempt to steal someone else’s idea and portray it as your own, which is both unlawful and unethical. Plagiarism detection is described as the automatic detection of written items that have been reused. Modern Plagiarism detection software often examines text documents using a text representation and text similarity approaches to look for words that appear in both suspicious and source documents. The widespread use of the internet and simple access to textual content has increased the demand for automated plagiarism detection. This paper proposes an intelligent approach to detect semantic plagiarism in scientific papers. A corpus for storing the text of source scientific papers in order to compare the suspicious documents with it and detect plagiarism have been created. The documents are clustered into numerous groups using the Mini-Batch K-Means clustering algorithm, then get the documents in a specified category. The Universal Sentence Encoder (USE) intelligent model, was employed to extract textual features. The report of plagiarism percentage will be displayed as a web page and can be downloaded as a pdf file. A decision is made to accept or reject the suspicious scientific paper according to a threshold value. To evaluate the proposed system, it is compared with Turnitin platform for Plagiarism Detection (PD), the result of comparison indicates that the proposed system is reliable. The findings promote and can reduce the percentage of plagiarism after deleting some unnecessary parts of the suspicious document.

articleTitle: Challenges Performance Facing Global Virtual Teams In Global Software Development:Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Global technological progress has increased the demand for software applications to manage new technology and employ it in various fields. Moreover, it has contributed to the emergence of a new approach in software development, which is (software globalization), that is, global software development (GSD) by building global virtual teams (GVT) that are geographically spread and different Culturally, you can work from anywhere in the world without the need to be in one place or to see each other daily. Teams communicate with each other through information and communication technology (such as e-mail, telephone, and online video conferencing) and through which information and data are exchanged, which helped reduce travel costs between company branches and reduce the money, time, and effort required to develop software. (GVTs) spread to benefit from the diversity of global expertise and obtain them at low wages in addition to the possibility of working 24 hours and seven days a week, in addition to the proximity to the markets, which helped to understand the requirements of the market and customers and reduce the time for the product to reach the markets, which helped to develop programs Global high quality and affordable cost that can compete and meet the needs of the global software market. A set of challenges and factors have emerged that face (GVTs), represented by: (Leadership, Communication, Cultural differences, Language problems, Time-zone differences, Lack of trust, Group Cohesion, training, Coordination of Expertise, Mutual Support, Team size, ICT problems, ….)These factors have greatly affected the performance of (GVTs) in developing global software. This paper aims to conduct a literature review to determine the Challenges Performance Facing Global Virtual Teams In Global Software Development.

articleTitle: Selecting Embedded Feature Modeling with Software Product Line for Smart Home Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) for environmental applications such as smart homes, campuses, cities, and health care systems are used to connect various wireless devices. Despite the use of the same devices, the reusability of these applications enables developers and software engineers to make enhancements to the development process according to the requirements of end users. However, the large number of variations in IoT technologies makes it hard for the developers or software engineers to select the default features in each application because of compatibility issues among devices. In this paper, Software Product Line (SPL) approach is proposed to design and manage the variabilities and commonalities among smart home applications. An embedded feature selection mechanism is proposed to classify the services by selecting the optimal subset feature. The selected subset features are those that are highly correlated and consistent with other features. The dataset is generated using open smart home simulator (OpenSHS) for daily activities within the virtual environment. The subset of features is evaluated by the level of consistency in each service. Weka data mining tool is used to find the classifier such as Bayes network and decision table which achieve the best accuracies on the dataset obtained in order to support services for residents in smart home applications. The approach adopted is based on a set of predefined performance metrics in order to compare the results for each classifier in terms of its ability to classify the services. It has been found that the Bayes network achieves an accuracy over 84.0% while the decision table achieved an accuracy over 83.0%.

articleTitle: Estimation of Rayleigh Process Parameters Using Classical and Intelligent Methods with Application
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: In this paper, in this paper, the parameters of the Rayleigh process in the non-homogeneous Poisson process were estimated using the GWO method and the PSO method and compared with the maximum likelihood estimation method. It is found that GWO method can guarantee more accurate results with rapid convergence to the maximum value of the function in less iterations in comparison to the classical Maximum Likelihood Estimation method (MLE). Moreover, the simulated estimates for the parameter by GWO shows more satisfactory results than the other methods. Finally, the idea and results of this paper is applied to a real-life application, which studies the intervals between successive failures in days for the Badush Cement Factory in Nineveh Governorate during the period from 1/4/2018 to 31/1/2019.

articleTitle: Software effort estimation Based on long short term memory and stacked long short term memory
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Software effort estimation (SEE) is an important process for predicting the effort required to develop or maintain software projects. It is considered one of the difficult challenges for software engineering because the more accurate the estimation, the greater the chances of success in developing software projects to complete and deliver them within the specified scheduling and budget. The diversity in software projects led to the use of many techniques to estimate the effort. The main objective of the research is to find the best technique to get the estimated effort as close to the real effort, using Machine learning Algorithms, artificial neural network Long Short-Term Memory(LSTM) and the artificial neural network Stacked Long Short-Term Memory (Stacked_LSTM), with six data sets are China, Kitchenham, Kemerer, Cocomo 81, Albrecht, Decharnais, and comparing the performance of the two machine learning algorithms performance, Neuralnet and Lasso from previous research, used the same data sets and using the same evaluation metrics, which are: the root mean square error (RMSE), mean absolute error (MAE) and R_Squared. The results demonstrated the superiority of the Stacked _LSTM algorithm by all metrics with the dataset of China, Kemerer and Albrecht, while in the data sets, Descharnais and Kitchenham, the LSTM algorithm outperformed the rest of the methods. While in the Cocomo 81 dataset, Neuralnet algorithm outperformed the rest of the techniques used, but the best rating was obtained. It is for Stacked _LSTM algorithm with China data.

articleTitle: A Survey on Real Time Cloud-based Robotics Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Cloud-based robotics has surfaced as a technology that allows robots and cloud services to work together. Advances in high-speed Networks, huge data storage, and high computing power have made it possible. Robots benefit from cloud computing because it provides them with more powerful processing capabilities and larger data storage capacities. It also provides open-source software, large databases, and cooperative learning opportunities through information sharing. Recent advancements in cloud robotics have prompted on-going research in this area. In this survey article, we look at the latest developments in cloud-based robotic and its application. We collect bits of information on the most recent developments in cloud-based robotic and examine the problem and constraints in momentum writing, as well as open research topics and future exploration directions.

publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)

abstract: In recent years, there has been a vast and massive development in device technology and new emerging technologies. Through them, there are new ways to collect data continuously and remarkably, such as: sensor networks, mobile devices, satellites, telecommunications, health care sectors, communication organizations, etc. This kind of data is called a data stream. A data stream is a series of elements and data that come from many different sources. Here, the need arises for quick data stream processing systems that process data in the shortest amount of time. The research aims to study the following algorithms and techniques, the challenges of the broadcast data, and the tools used to process this stream according to real-time requirements. The contributions of this study are to understand data streams, online processing and execution, concept drift detection, and the selection of the best tools for decision-making.

articleTitle: Improvement of Semantic-BERT Model with Bidirectional LSTM for Arabic Language
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Large, pretrained transformer-based approaches like BERT have transformed the Natural Language Processing (NLP) field. BERT is a multilayer bidirectional Transformer trained on plaintext for masked word prediction and last sentence prediction. The pretrained BERT model can then be finetuned with task-specific training data for a subsequent task, The Improvement of BERT results are one of the main challenges that many studies focus on recently. In this work we proposed a Semantic-Bert model for Arabic Question/ Answer (Q/A) applications that incorporates explicit contextual semantics from pretrained semantic role labeling. It also introduces an enhanced language representation model, which is called Semantics aware BERT. The model is utilized bidirectional Long short-term memory LSTM (Bi-LSTM) to improve the correction in retrieving the answer when it selects the correct paragraph. The model is trained for 200 epoch and the results show that the proposed model achieves 0.75% and 80% in sensitivity. In addition, it achieves 61.5% and 90.4% in the sentence match. The selection of answering for most questions is highly accurate that most answers near from what need. Based on these results, it can be indicated that the proposed model is able to retrieve the answer correctly as it chooses the correct paragraph.

articleTitle: Robust Sign Language Interpreter for Deaf Persons
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: The present study focuses on a category of people who suffer from disorders of hearing and/or speaking and communicating orally with others, they are deaf and usually have difficulties in learning how to write and read text. That is why sign language has emerged as an effective alternative to expressing their thoughts, and that most people (who hear) do not know sign language, in this research, the development of an application design on a mobile phone that works without the use of the internet, to translate the Iraqi sign language through the development of the system to include copying text messages and converting them into sign language. Also, in the event that the word does not exist in the database, a note will be displayed to the recipient explaining that the apparent translation is an alphabetic translation and not a real translation, as well as adding a photo capture icon to take a picture for any text to be translated. As a result of applying the system to a number of volunteers, according to a questionnaire that was conducted for them, the system was 100 % efficient and accurate. It was programmed in Java under the Android environment, and the application interfaces were designed using the Extensible Markup Language (XML) Then it was implemented and tested under the environment of the Android operating system version (9.0). The Blender program was used to design images that represent words, letters and sign language numbers.

Author Keywords: Arabic sign language Persons with disabilities

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Software Vulnerability Detection: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Software is increasingly becoming more prevalent in all aspects of life. All modern businesses, services, and products are dependent on software either directly or in an indirect way. Due to this widespread, software vulnerabilities are evolving into a prominent concern not only to cybersecurity specialists and software engineers but also to people that use the software. With this expansion of software, there was an accompanying increase in the number of disclosed software vulnerabilities. Consequently, this rising number of revealed vulnerabilities leads to deducing that the current software vulnerabilities detection approaches are not coping with the challenges, and there is an urgent need to better alternatives. The great success of machine learning-based techniques in various fields and the incredible growth of open-source software code base have attracted researchers and cybersecurity specialists to develop machine learning models for software vulnerabilities detection. In this article, we surveyed the research papers regarding machine learning approaches for software vulnerabilities detection. The study highlighted the techniques and datasets that have been used by the researchers and the result that they have achieved.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study Among Some Natural-Inspired Optimization Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Biologically inspired algorithms such as Ant colony optimization (ACO), Firefly algorithm (FA), Artificial Bee Colony (ABC), biogeography-based optimization algorithm (BBO) and teaching learning-based optimization (TLBO) are among the most effective algorithms used for optimization. These algorithms are able to solve real-world optimization problems and discover optimal or nearly optimal solutions in a realistic time. Actually, these algorithms have different performance quality in solving various problems based on convergence speed and finding the optimal solution. So, this paper intends to make a comparative study among ABC, FA and TLBO algorithms in terms of minimum, maximum, mean and standard deviation based on some benchmark functions which are Sphere, Rosenbrock, Ackley, Schwefel and Rastrigin functions. The experimental results show that the performance of the TLBO algorithm is superior to other optimization algorithms.

articleTitle: Lightweight Encryption for IoT Using Dynamic Stream Key
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: IoT applications have covered many aspects of our daily lives, such as smart cities, smart buildings, smart homes, and healthcare monitoring. One of the problems with the Internet of Things is dealing with and securing the huge amount of data generated by heterogeneous IoT devices. These interconnected devices need to gather real-time information and connect them to other cloud resources to collect, store, and analyze different data streams. All of these processes’ effects on security of sensitive information. Therefore, it was necessary to secure the data resulting from these applications. Classical encryption algorithms were not suitable for Internet of Things constraint devices due to limited memory, power, and simple processing capabilities. In this paper a lightweight encryption algorithm was proposed to encrypt images for secure data transfer in the internet of things platforms and wireless networking with fog/edge computing. The proposed algorithm utilizes the power of One-Time Pad (OTP) key generated by a Dynamic Linear Feedback Shift Register (DLFSR). The good statistical test analysis for generated key and ciphertext and the algorithm high performance evaluation suggest the suitability of the proposed encryption for providing security in constrained devices. Experimental results show the efficiency of the proposed algorithm as compared to the previous works.

articleTitle: Scraping Google Scholar Data Using Cloud Computing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: The current revolution in Internet technologies has led to a tremendous amount of data on the world wide web (www). Dealing with such big data is not an easy task in terms of collection and analysis. Moreover, the unstructured nature of most of this data makes it more difficult to collect and analyze. Therefore, scraping and crawling techniques are considered the most common types of data collection from the web. In this paper, a scraper is developed based on two methods to scrape data from one of the most complicated platforms on the web, which is Google scholar. These two methods are Beautiful Soup and SERP API. The proposed scraper is divided into three parts: the web scraper finds the needed links on the internet, the data is extracted from the source links, and lastly the data is stored in a CSV file. For implementing the scraper, Python language is used. The results showed that the designed scraper is efficient in retrieving data from Google scholar. Also, it was found that Python is a suitable and efficient language for scraping necessary data from a particular website of interest due to the abundance of library resources.

articleTitle: Robust Cox-Regression and Bootstrap to Estimate Breast Cancer Patients Model In Nineveh Province
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Cox-Regression is a well-known approach to model censored survival data and able to show the effect of at least one of the factors that changes over time. On the other hand it violates the hazard ratio assumption. There are many ways to deal appropriately with Non-proportional hazards, especially by including parameters for time-dependent effects. In the existence of outliers, the weighted Cox-Regression model with robust weights is a suitable alternative to get robust estimates without additional parameters. This paper deals with such a problem based on detecting outliers and proposing different robust weighting functions to get estimated models that are more robust than the classical methods. Proposed weighting schemes are applied to a set of data of breast cancer patients in Nineveh province/Iraq in order to prove the effectiveness of weights and then running a comparison between models estimated by some efficiency criteria. The Bootstrap technique is then applied to test the efficiency of the estimated models. Overall analysis shows that The Average Hazard Ratio (AHR) method over performs all other weighting schemes.

articleTitle: Real-Time data packet scheduling in WSNs: An Overview
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Limited computational resources in Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) considered a key challenge in sensor environment. With such constraints on the network topology, scheduling real-time and non-real-time data packet could not perform as expected as on other type of the wireless environment, eventually, could have an impact on the network performance in terms of power degradation and average latency. This paper presents the base packet scheduling structure alongside the classification of packet scheduling algorithms and examples of most well-known algorithms for each class of scheduling scheme. Additionally, the authors highlight some weak points in each presented example in order to give a deep understanding of packet scheduling classes and algorithms.

articleTitle: Detection Mechanisms for Peer-to-Peer Botnets: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Cybercrimes are becoming a bigger menace to both people and corporations. It poses a serious challenge to the modern digital world. According to Cybersecurity Ventures, the global cost of cybercrime will reach ${\$}$10.5 trillion annually by 2025, which is significantly more than the annual damage caused by all-natural disasters and more profitable than the global trade in all major illegal narcotics put together. Botnets are the most common and have a significant negative impact on any civilization among malware programs. As a result, this study will explore various P2P botnet detection algorithms by outlining their essential characteristics, advantages and disadvantages, obstacles, and future research.

articleTitle: A Brief Review of Advanced Monitoring Mechanisms in Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Botnets
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Due to threats from botnets, internet security is becoming less safe. An attack plan can only be planned out to take down the botnet after the monitoring activities to understand the behavior of a botnet. Nowadays, the architecture of the botnet is developed using a Peer-to-Peer (P2P) connection, causing it to be harder to be monitored and tracked down. This paper is mainly about existing botnet monitoring tools. The aim of this manuscript is to investigate the ways to monitor a botnet and how the monitoring mechanism works. The monitoring tools are categorized into active and passive mechanisms. A crawler is an active mechanism, while sensor and Honeypot are the passive mechanisms. Previous work about each mechanism is present in this paper as well.

articleTitle: Physics-Informed Neural Networks and their Implementation in MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: An analysis was made of physics-informed neural networks used to solve partial differential equations. The prospects for the implementation of physics-informed neural networks in the MATLAB system are shown. An algorithm for solving partial differential equations in MATLAB using physics-informed neural networks has been developed. On the example of a model problem described by the Poisson equation, physics-informed neural networks were implemented and studied, which showed that MATLAB can be successfully used to implement such networks. MATLAB made it possible to solve the Poisson equation up to the mean square value of the loss function equal to 0.01. The best results were obtained by networks with a small number of layers (3–4) and a sufficiently large number of neurons in each layer (50–100). Comparison with known results showed that MATLAB was inferior to TensorFlow in terms of learning speed. The application of the Optimization Toolbox MATLAB for the implementation of the L-BFGS quasi-Newtonian learning algorithm for physics-informed neural networks was studied. The quasi-Newtonian algorithm makes it possible to increase the accuracy of solving the problem, but requires a lot of training time. As further research, it is recommended to expand the capabilities of the Deep Learning Toolbox by including quasi-Newtonian learning algorithms, in particular, the Levenberg-Marquard algorithm, and new neural network architectures, for example, networks of radial basis functions.

articleTitle: Detection and Classification of Melanoma by Analysis of Skin Lesions Using Teledermatology
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: One of the worst kinds of skin cancer is called melanoma. Melanoma may be automatically diagnosed from dermoscopy images using image analysis algorithms, which involve segmenting lesions, basic processing, extracting dermoscopic characteristics, and identifying illnesses. The proposed skin lesion analysis method intends to enhance early melanoma detection to reduce mortality and wasteful biopsies. For classification of the ISIC archive dataset, we use the K-Means clustering algorithm and thresholding for lesion segmentation; the Sobel operator and the median filter for preprocessing; the GLCM and LBP features for feature extraction; and the Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier. The obtained results achieved 93.28% accuracy. As well as transferring the clinical images to a dermatologist via a networking app (such as WhatsApp) for examination at a separate time and place to follow up on patients during the presence of the pandemic or those who live in remote areas.

articleTitle: Prospects and Challenges of the Cloud of Things in Telemedicine
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: Several works have intensive on modeling telemedicine smart by merging the Internet of Things (IoT) with cloud computing technology to produce what is called the Cloud of Things (CoT). Cloud of Things (CoT) has grown as the greatest promising technology in academics and industry for novelty. Cat assists numerous developing sectors such as health, energy, smart home, and vehicle. IoT devices are playing an important role in patient health monitoring. Some connected devices are assisting in the creation of smart hospitals, improving patients’ lives, and improving the conditions of care for the elderly in areas where patient care mechanisms can be improved. This study discusses the concept of integrated health care with CoT and its current position in this direction. In addition, it supplements the literature with a systematic review covering the location of the technology in a home or hospital. It also presents the most important classification of challenges and issues that impede the advancement of this technology.

articleTitle: Classification of Written and Spoken Arabic Letters based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Contemporary Information Technology and Mathematics (ICCITM)
abstract: This research focuses on automatic Arabic speech recognition (AASR) (Arabic characters) as well as Arabic character handwriting recognition. The Mel Spectrogram is used to calculate the spectral slope coefficient. The major applications of a convolutional neural network (CNN) are feature learning and classification. In automatic speech recognition, CNN has improved its performance (ASR). In addition, it is used to recognize handwritten Arabic letters. Put the CNN model to the test using the Arabic pronunciation set for Arabic letters, and made some tweaks to it by adjusting pitch, speed, dynamic range, introducing noise, and moving forward and backward in time. The greatest accuracy attained while employing (Mel Spectrogram) with CNN was reported to be 99.4%. When compared to earlier studies, the findings show that CNN performed much higher in the AASR. When the same CNN model was tested with handwritten Arabic letters, the outcome was 98.8%.
